entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2905 of 2023

Applicant :- Nandu @ Nandu Yadav And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Mulayam Singh Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Mulayam Singh Yadav, the learned counsel for the applicants as well as Ms. Charu
Singh, learned A.G.A. appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2.  This is a second anticipatory bail application field by the applicants seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No. 260 of 2021, under Sections 376-D, 323, 325 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Risia, District Bahraich.

The first anticipatory bail application was rejected by means of an order dated 03.08.2022.
3.

The second anticipatory bail application has been filed on the ground that subsequent to rejection of the applicants anticipatory bail application, two co-accused persons Nitish Yadav and Dhillar Yadav were granted anticipatory bail by means of an order dated 06.08.2022 and their application has been finally allowed by means of an order dated 14.07.2023 as no counter affidavit was filed either by the State or by the informant.
Nandu @ Nandu Yadav And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Nandu @ Nandu Yadav And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The aforesaid case has been rejected on the basis of F.I.R lodged on 08.10.2021 alleging that all the four accused persons had molested the informant and tried to rape her and when her bother-in-law tried to save her he was assaulted with sticks and sharp edge weapon.
5. None of the allegations were reported by the medico legal examination report.
6.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she alleged commission of rape but this allegation also could not be supported by the findings of the medico legal examination report.

The victim had stated that her brother-in-law was walking some distance ahead of her at the time of the incident and he tried to intervene and yet all the accused persons raped her and neither the informant nor the brother-in-law received any injuries in the incident.
7. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that both the other co-accused persons have already been granted anticipatory bail in the present case and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the applicants are also entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in the present case.
9. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.
